name: Granola
description: Ask questions about your meetings and read your Granola notes, attendees and transcripts through Granola's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Granola account.
examples: Summarize my meetings from this week and list the action items assigned to me.
What did we decide about pricing in my most recent meeting with Acme?
List yesterday's meetings with their attendees and a one-line summary of each.

zh-CN.name: Granola
zh-CN.description: 通过 Granola 官方托管的 MCP 服务询问你的会议情况，读取 Granola 笔记、参会人与转写稿。用 Granola 账号登录。
examples: 概括我这周的会议，并列出分配给我的待办事项。
我最近一次和 Acme 开会时，定价方面做了什么决定？
列出昨天的会议、参会人，并各用一句话概括。
